plan.title: Existing-observation projection and prospective disclosure value qualification

g7.depth: D2=root+2 continuations; inferential horizon>2. D0 capacity-matched columns with continuation descriptor zeroed.

fit.source: Stage 3G.7 OPEN fit set (seed 8013, 320 rows), hash-verified by its committed manifest; reused unchanged so BASELINE_G7 is the certified Stage 3G.7 head. No Stage 3G.8 OPEN rows are generated.

seeds.admission: Unmodified corpusRecord. Families A/B: equal level x horizon-band x objective quotas over fixed eight-seed panels in canonical combination order (Stage 3G.7 traversal), unit weights, no action or outcome oversampling; quota is checked before a record is built. Cohorts BYPASS_A/B: horizon bands H2-H4 only, admitted iff the offered menu contains BYPASS (screened on the rebuilt t0 world before labels), level x band quota 9, canonical order, shortfalls recorded; conditional descriptive cohorts with population weight 0. Record/world/topology hashes disjoint from all prior lineage and across partitions.
seeds.precision: Population quota is 96 per family x level x band (Stage 3G.7 used 24) so that the registered noninferiority endpoints can resolve; methodology, margins and resampling are otherwise unchanged.

BASELINE_G7.fit: FROZEN: Stage 3G.7 OPEN QUALIFIED_512 weights; refit on reused OPEN evidence must reproduce its model hash

TYPED_RELATION_ONLY.columns: G7 54 with typed continuation pruning + TYPED_RELATION 27

TYPED_SEARCH_ONLY.columns: G7 54 with typed continuation pruning only

RUNTIME_PLUS_CURRENT_PRIVATE.role: AUDIT_ONLY diagnostic: individual health, available, planned, acceptsMaterial, protected, value/quantity of the root target

definitions.RETREAT: a RETREAT root is in the optimal set (Stage 3G.7 definition)
definitions.TARGET_BEARING: offered menu contains a targeted root other than PROTECT (observable, pre-decision)
definitions.OOD: sealed rows with level>=4 and horizon>2 for heads fit on OPEN level<=3

statistics.material: Stage 3G.7 rule: mean hit gain >= .05, paired 95% percentile lower bound > 0 and normalized regret not worse. A claim requires both families (replication); n<100 in either family is NOT_TESTABLE. HARMFUL is the mirror rule.
statistics.noninferiority: One-sided, Bonferroni over the registered NI family, deterministic paired percentile bootstrap with 40,000 resamples: PASS iff hit-deficit upper < .05 and nreg-excess upper < .01; FAIL iff a lower bound reaches a margin; else NOT_TESTABLE.
statistics.bootstrap: deterministic paired percentile, unit row weights, seed STAGE3G8:<key>

audits.objectiveFidelity: Per row: packet metadata.objectives equals kernel world.objectives (audit read); reconstructObjectives(project(packet)) equals the packet exactly; summed remaining equals packet feature[12].
audits.bypass: Per offered BYPASS root on every row: coarse identifiability (exactly one in-service supports source), typed t0 prediction, and the actual kernel rewiring from symmetricStep (audit only).
audits.subtypeVOI: Oracle value-of-information audit, audit-only: permute canonical types within each coarse collapse group (multiset preserving, seeded by record hash, at most 8 attempts); accept the first permutation that changes a type and leaves the delivered observation (features, canonicalState, objectives, history, visible map) and the offered menu identical. Evaluate the unchanged frozen counterfactual oracle on that world. decisionRelevant = optimal set differs; misbeliefHitLoss = 1 - mean actual optimality of the alternative optimal set. Rows with no consistent alternative contribute 0.
audits.materiallyRelevantPath: In both population families: share of inferential rows with BYPASS offered and coarse-ambiguous substitute >= .05, OR mean subtype misbelief hit loss >= .05 with paired 95% lower > 0.
audits.integrity: Every 25th row (stored equivariance sample): D4 twins, order-preserving identity renaming with reversed candidate order, Stage 3G.7-style non-monotone renaming for identity-independent columns, privileged poisoning, recomputation determinism, privileged key scan; and frozen Stage 3G.7 observableColumns parity on every row and candidate.

decisionRules.OBJECTIVE_PROGRESS_VALUE_MATERIAL: C1 MATERIAL replicated in A and B on ALL
decisionRules.OBJECTIVE_PROGRESS_OOD_STABLE: OOD_OBJECTIVE_PROGRESS NI PASS in A and B -> true; FAIL in either -> false; otherwise NOT_TESTABLE
decisionRules.TYPED_RELATION_DECISION_VALUE_MATERIAL: C2 or C4 MATERIAL replicated on ALL or TARGET_BEARING, or in both BYPASS cohorts
decisionRules.TYPED_RELATION_DISCLOSURE_JUSTIFIED: eligible safety audit AND real collision (fixture pair + natural coarse-ambiguous BYPASS > 0) AND (decision value material OR (exact semantics required AND materially relevant path)) AND no leakage AND replication
decisionRules.TYPED_RELATION_SCHEMA_SUPPORT_JUSTIFIED: eligible safety audit AND real collision AND typed prediction exact on every natural and fixture BYPASS AND no leakage (mechanistic; not decision value)
decisionRules.TARGET_SEMANTICS_SUFFICIENT: objective projection complete AND every unavailable target predicate explicitly UNKNOWN with zero false certainty AND S1 NI PASS in A and B AND no replicated material C6 gap in any testable population stratum. Sufficiency is relative to the environment observation boundary and the demonstrated population; absent action cells are reported NOT_DEMONSTRATED.
decisionRules.DEPENDENCY_SEMANTICS_SUFFICIENT: Exact dependency effect identifiable on the surface (Stage 3G.7 meaning). Current runtime: requires coarse identifiability on every natural BYPASS. With disclosure: typed prediction exact on every natural and fixture BYPASS.
decisionRules.SCIENTIFICALLY_SUFFICIENT_WITH_DISCLOSUR: TARGET_SEMANTICS_SUFFICIENT AND DEPENDENCY_SEMANTICS_SUFFICIENT_WITH_DISCLOSURE AND S2 NI PASS in A and B AND no replicated material C7 gap AND root legality parity AND UNKNOWN safety
decisionRules.CURRENT_RUNTIME_SUFFICIENT: TARGET_SEMANTICS_SUFFICIENT AND current-runtime DEPENDENCY_SEMANTICS_SUFFICIENT AND S1 NI PASS AND root legality parity AND UNKNOWN safety. Audit-only fields never make it true.
decisionRules.DEPLOYABLE_PLANNING_SUFFICIENT: ACTION_SURFACE_SUFFICIENT AND inherited SEARCH_BUDGET_SUFFICIENT passes on the full domain (inherited NOT_TESTABLE_ON_FULL_REQUIRED_DOMAIN; not re-tested here)
STAGE3G_CLOSURE: C1 epistemic integrity certified (3G.1/3G.2 reproduced; Stage 3G.8 integrity all pass)
C2 observable current state sufficient for demonstrated tasks = SCIENTIFICALLY_SUFFICIENT_WITH_DISCLOSURE
C3 remaining unavailable fields explicitly UNKNOWN (boundary V2 audit)
C5 environment-dynamics value non-material (Stage 3G.7 replicated environment gate false in every testable stratum; reproduced)
C6 no learned world model justified (C5 and C8)
C7 remaining adapter-contract improvements understood and scoped (typed disclosure eligible, collision resolved prospectively, its decision value measured; objective projection complete)
C8 no unresolved issue requires counterfactual prediction (hidden-health collision is current information; C5)
decisionRules.blocker: If closure fails, name exactly the first failing condition in C1..C8 order.

plan.fixtures: Stage 3G.7 BYPASS collision pair, multi-substitute lexical renaming and hidden-health collision re-run under CURRENT_COARSE_RELATION and PROSPECTIVE_TYPED_RELATION; reachable COLLECT->TRANSFER trajectory for nonzero delivered objective fidelity and replay. Population weight 0.
